# health — index

Physical and mental health history. The psychological profile itself lives
in [[wiki/mind/profile/index]]; this domain covers the body and the
chemistry.

- [[wiki/health/chemical-architecture]] — the engineered substance stack: Suboxone since Feb 17 2010 (zero relapses), daily cocaine/nicotine/cannabis, hard zero on alcohol; supply logistics; the frame and its audit.
- [[wiki/health/cocaine]] — cocaine: the daily stimulant — twenty-year use history, the dosage arc (1g → 3.5–7g → 0.5–1g), family exposure at age 13, first use at 17–18, legal history, and the supply chain built to deliver it.
- [[wiki/health/intake-ledger]] — **the database**: every unit and every intake event on the record, generated from `intake/events.jsonl`. Evidence rather than a claim — a dated first-party consumption record to set against the pages that describe the same behaviour from memory.
- [[wiki/health/hyperreflexivity]] — a self-initiated AI-collaborative session naming and mechanizing Dan's social anxiety; raises an unresolved tension with the Suboxone maintenance dose and supplies a dateable mid-2025 return-to-work data point.
- [[wiki/timeline/periods/dark-era-2007-2008]] — the 2007–2008 opiate onset (heroin explicitly rejected, oxycodone chosen) and a previously undocumented eating disorder, both tracing to the November 2005 family rupture.
- [[wiki/health/the-configured-body]] — junction: the body is specified at the input and surveilled at the output, and never maintained. The composition regime and the substance stack are one faculty; hyperreflexivity is the other; between them there is no preventive care, no repair regime and no baseline in seventeen years. Closes the prescriber gap and corrects the "no dental anywhere" claim.
